title: Fake Minecraft Mod Drops Myth Stealer RAT to Steal Passwords and Remotely Control PCs
content_md: A trojanized Minecraft optimization mod posing as a companion to the legitimate Lithium project has been used to deploy Myth Stealer 3.2-FIX, a password-stealing malware family with remote-access, surveillance, persistence, and victim-harassment capabilities.
